column1: # Regression limits for the `ratio_host` rows of budgets.tsv, per CPU model (rule P10).
# Columns: cpu, benchmark, row, limit, status, rationale.
#   cpu        the `model name` string of /proc/cpuinfo, exactly (not the host name). A CPU with no
#              entry for a row is measured and reported but not gated (`cargo xtask bench` says so).
#   limit      the most the same-run MEDIAN Liella/glibc ratio over the rounds may be (the number
#              `cargo xtask bench --compare` prints as the ratio; not the worst round).
#   status     `gate`: an ordinary regression limit. `known_regression`: a confirmed slowdown kept at
#              its earlier bound; the run FAILS on it, labelled "known regression, PERF-REGRESS", until
#              the slowdown is fixed (then the row becomes `gate` with a limit from its new median).
#   rationale  where the limit comes from. A limit is 1.25 x the median ratio measured on that CPU
#              (2026-10-05, the merged tree). A limit raised above the earlier one carries its reason:
#              "noise (DRIFT-CHECK)" or "confirmed and accepted (<who/why>)". Nothing is accepted yet.
# The TARGET (ratio <= 1.10) is separate and informational; see budgets.tsv.
